page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is a virtual workstation instance belonging to the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores and 4 threads of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The CPU architecture is x86_64, featuring 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX and AVX-512 extensions. The server is configured with 23.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.75 GB of RAM per vCPU, and is paired with a fractional 0.25 NVIDIA T4 GPU allocating 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local disk storage is not bundled, requiring network-attached storage, while baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate that compute and memory throughput are modest compared to full-socket and high-density instances. The instance recorded a single-core Geekbench score of 904.0 and a multi-core score of 2011.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 3597.24 and a stress-ng multi-core rating of 2934.21, placing general compute performance in the lower benchmark quartiles. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reached 19.82 GB/sec, while write operations measured 18.77 GB/sec. Redis operations registered at 2.82 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reached 3.32 GB/sec. For machine learning tasks, inference throughput on a 135M parameter language model delivered 233.71 prompt tokens per second and 64.28 generation tokens per second.

From an architectural standpoint, the fractional GPU configuration offers a cost-effective path to hardware-accelerated graphics and light neural network processing without the financial overhead of dedicating a full GPU. However, the 4 GB VRAM limit and lower-tier CPU throughput constrain the server when executing large model training or demanding multi-threaded compile tasks. The ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is suited for cloud-hosted graphical workstations, lightweight 3D rendering, video encoding, small-scale deep learning inference, and remote visualization applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud server featuring 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 23.0 GB of system memory and incorporates a partitioned NVIDIA T4 graphics processor providing 0.25 of the physical GPU and 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. The system provides no integrated local storage and operates with a 2 Gbps baseline network throughput. Standardized CPU and memory benchmarks reflect lower-quartile performance, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 2011.0 and uncached memory read bandwidth of 19.82 GB/sec. Despite lower raw CPU compute throughput, the fractional T4 accelerator enables economical execution of graphics-driven applications and modest machine learning workloads. The configuration is primarily tailored for virtual desktop infrastructure, remote graphical workstations, lightweight 3D modeling, and small-scale neural network inference.
